# Brand Context — Visual

## Colors
- primary:   #1b4d3e
- secondary: #0d2620
- accent:    #c6a04a
- text-on-light: #0d2620
- text-on-dark:  #ffffff

## Logo files
- light background: assets/logo-light.png
- dark background:  assets/logo-dark.png
- mark only:        assets/logo-light.png
- minimum width:    140 px
- clear space:      28 px
- default placement: bottom-left

## Typography
- headline font: DejaVuSans
- body font:     DejaVuSans
- headline case: title
- max headline length: 60 characters

## Photography style
- Preferred: warm natural light, wide interiors, lived-in staging, lake and water context
- Avoid: HDR halos, fisheye, empty twilight exteriors, stock-looking people

## Brokerage co-branding
- brokerage logo required on every asset? no
- brokerage logo path: n/a
- relative size vs agent logo: n/a
